faqs.question: What is the procedure to take MBA admission at Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Urdu, Arabi~Farsi University?
faqs.answer:
The procedure to take MBA admission at Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Urdu, Arabi-Farsi University is as follows:
Check the eligibility criteria: The minimum eligibility criteria for MBA admission is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST candidates).
Apply for the entrance exam: The candidate must apply for the entrance exam required for MBA admission. The university accepts UPSEE, CAT, NTA, and CMAT scores for MBA admission.
Appear for the entrance exam: The candidate must appear for the entrance exam and score the minimum cutoff marks required for MBA admission.

faqs.question: Does Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University have good placements?
faqs.answer: Placements at Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University are decent. During the recent placement drive, the the highest package offered to students was INR 9LPA and average was INR 6 LPA. Almost 70-80 percent students got placed. Companies like Microsoft, Tech Mahindra, and Genpact were the top recruiters. According to the reviews, students should not expect a very good placement from this intitute. The resonable fees structure should also be kept in mind, the fees for each and every course available to pursue at this institute is very less. And if we compare the fees to the placements, we can say that students can get a good return on thier fees invested.

faqs.question: Is Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University BSc course expensive than Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Avadh University?
faqs.answer:
Both Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University and Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Avadh University are state-university that offer various courses at UG, PG, and Diploma levels. However, Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University courses are less expensive in comparison to Dr. Ram Manohar University. At Dr. Ram Manohar University the courses are offered by its affiliated colleges, which makes the BSc course fee a bit expensive compared to Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and learning environment with average placement and supportive faculty.

review_content.Placements: I am from B.Tech CSE (AI&ML). 60-70% of students from my course are placed through campus recruitment at approximately 6 LPA. The lowest package is 2 LPA - 3 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Infosys is the top company, along with a few startups. 80% (UPSDM) get internships as cybersecurity analysts.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities of the computer science department are satisfactory and support both academic and learning activities. The campus is fully Wi-Fi connected and has a computer lab with an AI updated system. It has well-maintained computer labs with smart classrooms.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members are nice and good..

review_content.Placements: The maximum number of seats for my course is 120, and we have over 60 students in class. B.Sc. courses do not provide recruitment.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is very good, with there is quite a good amount of books. The infrastructure of the library is also nice, and the overall campus is beautiful. The main academic block is also good. Currently, the university is under construction, but the campus is still beautiful. Classrooms are spacious.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members are nice, and the course curriculum is also relevant. Exams are moderate, and there are strict rules during examinations. Teachers are qualified, knowledgeable, and friendly. They also make sure that you understand everything they teach. If you focus on your lectures, you will do well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: My college days are the best part of my life.

review_content.Placements: 65% of students were placed with the highest package of 5.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. There are some companies, like Samsung, Microsoft, Google, and HCL, and also construction companies that provide student placement and internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is the best quality of food and facilities of the hostel. In the hostel facility, Wi-Fi is available RO water is available and there is also geyser. There are some play activities like table tennis, badminton, and also table tennis. Medical faculty are good. Hostels in my area are really eco friendly and the best ability of electricity and innovation is also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: My university at a glance.

review_content.Placements: The main problem here is the placement issue. Because the placement rate is very poor. Hardly any student got placements from this university. A few students got placed in companies like HDFC Bank, Zepto etc. The internship rate is also very poor and no one got an internship from here.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have good infrastructure. The department has Wi-Fi and a library with all books. The university has a playground and canteen. Classrooms are also excellent. They are air-conditioned and have all the basic equipment and facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of the infrastructure, smart classes, and helpful and friendly faculty.

review_content.Placements: The placements are average. Around 50-60% of students get placed overall. The highest package is around 10 LPA, while the lowest package is 1.8 LPA. The recruiting companies like U Certify, Pie Infocom, and Genpact have recruited students based on their requirements and talents. I am in my 3rd semester, and till now, none of us has been offered any kind of internship. The top roles that have been offered are Software Developer and Subject Matter Expert.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is the best. The seats are really comfortable, along with wide classrooms. Labs are well furnished, and the library has a wide range of books available in each field of study. Wi-Fi is available, and the systems in each lab have the best specifications. Hostel rooms are quite good, and the food quality is better than other hostels. For sports and games, a separate building is there, along with all the equipment and a proper gym.

Apart from this, many top companies such as Microsoft, Tech Mahindra, and Genpact among others visited the campus during the recent placement drive.

faqs.answer: Placements at Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University are decent. During the recent placement drive, the the highest package offered to students was INR 9LPA and average was INR 6 LPA . Almost 70-80 percent students got placed. Companies like Microsoft, Tech Mahindra, and Genpact were the top recruiters. According to the reviews, students should not expect a very good placement from this intitute. The resonable fees structure should also be kept in mind, the fees for each and every course available to pursue at this institute is very less. And if we compare the fees to the placements, we can say that students can get a good return on thier fees invested.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and learning environment with average placement and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities of the computer science department are satisfactory and support both academic and learning activities. The campus is fully Wi-Fi connected and has a computer lab with an AI updated system. It has well-maintained computer labs with smart classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are nice and good..
reviews.review_text: The library is very good, with there is quite a good amount of books. The infrastructure of the library is also nice, and the overall campus is beautiful. The main academic block is also good. Currently, the university is under construction, but the campus is still beautiful. Classrooms are spacious.

reviews.review_heading: My college days are the best part of my life.
reviews.review_text: There is the best quality of food and facilities of the hostel. In the hostel facility, Wi-Fi is available RO water is available and there is also  geyser. There are some play activities like table tennis, badminton, and also table tennis. Medical faculty are good. Hostels in my area are really eco friendly and the best ability of electricity and innovation is also available.

reviews.review_heading: My university at a glance.
reviews.review_text: We have good infrastructure. The department has Wi-Fi and a library with all books. The university has a playground and canteen. Classrooms are also excellent. They are air-conditioned and have all the basic equipment and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the infrastructure, smart classes, and helpful and friendly faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best. The seats are really comfortable, along with wide classrooms. Labs are well furnished, and the library has a wide range of books available in each field of study. Wi-Fi is available, and the systems in each lab have the best specifications. reviews.review_heading: About 5 to 6% of students only get placed.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good, with air conditioning in every class and good washrooms, and the department of labs and classes is very nice. The hostel is below average with cleaning and very nice accommodation. Sports and gyms are the best in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is not very good but the teacher is very supportive and helpful. And
reviews.review_text: The facilities is very supporting. And the infrastructure is very stylish and the main building is red in colour and the hostel rooms is in very good condition. The food in hostel is very good. We also have a volleyball and basketball team in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Not so good, not so bad.
reviews.review_text: I would rate the infrastructure as 3 because it’s neither poor nor good. Some classrooms have AC while others don't. reviews.review_heading: Why it will be beneficial for you to take admission here!
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the college available for my course was good. I got good classrooms with advanced teaching methods and a big, spacious lab with high-speed internet connection. If we talk about hostel, mess and canteen, then you will be fully satisfied with it.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best and underrated University of Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: The university has an amazing, grand-sized library; a student can make a library card and take books for free. All in all, the campus and facilities are average and do not leave the impression that students usually seek when selecting a college for their graduation.

faqs.question: What is the placement scenario at AMET Chennai?
faqs.answer: The majority of students received job opportunities at AMET Chennai placements in the operations sector. Candidates can fill out the application form on the institute's official website.
STEP 2: Selection
The institute selects candidates based on entrance exam scores. It also considers the candidates' academic performance for final selection.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The institute also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theEast West College of Engineering feeto confirm their seats at the institute.

reviews.review_heading: The college is so good at faculty and well-equipped labs.
reviews.review_text: Well and good, the college has good infrastructure, well-equipped labs, medium-sized classrooms with benches, good Wi-Fi, support for education, and assistance in sports, while the hostel is very good with 4-sharing rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, our experience in electronics and communication engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is okay but not too good. Many classrooms are old and lack proper lighting and ventilation. Some of the labs do not have enough working equipment, and students often have to wait or share tools. The hostel and washroom facilities also need a lot of improvement in terms of cleanliness and maintenance. reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for those who can't afford engineering.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the campus.
reviews.review_text: Not so much a big campus, a little bit small compared to all other engineering colleges present in Bangalore, but it will not make that much difference in studies, I think so. Hostel food is good compared to PG's food in Bangalore. I can say overall, out of 10, approximately 7-8, I would rate.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a well qualified teaching faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides a hostel facility with all the basic facilities likes AC bedrooms along with bathrooms. Water coolers and water purifiers are available. The food is very tasty and a canteen is also available in the campus. The infrastructure is beautiful, the classrooms are very nice and so are the labs. The library is good. Wifi is enabled with a high speed internet.

reviews.review_heading: One Of the Best College In Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: We have above-average facilities for departmental labs, classrooms, etc. The library provides most of the books needed for our course. The hostel is well-maintained. They provide good food and water facilities, but there are no medical facilities. We have a sports club for various sports activities, and it really engages students in their physical time.

reviews.review_heading: I got good friends with more knowledge .
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were good, with nice benches. The labs were good and had upgraded computers with internet connectivity and the hostel had a good mess. But the canteen and ground in the hostel were small and the hostel was 500m away from the college; it is outside the college campus .

reviews.review_heading: The best and good college
reviews.review_text: In East West College of Engineering, there are many infrastructural facilities, such as Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, and a library. In the hostel, the infrastructure and facilities are good, and hygienic food is available. Sports facilities and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: This college is not the worst and also not the best.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi is provided. Labs are good enough but sometimes their will be a shortage of systems. The hostel is neat and clean but the food is a little boring but better than before. Wi-Fi is not provided. We have a terrace and washing facilities to wash our clothes.

reviews.review_heading: An engineering story.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good. Faculty members are like friends. The teaching staffs is good. Wi-Fi is provided on each floor. The library is maintained well and nice. Labs are good with sufficient equipment. Classrooms are good. Hostel is good with better food facility and Wi-Fi Connection.

reviews.review_heading: 4 years of engineering life are good here.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of our college is quite good, and there is a field for playing.
Labs are not so good. 
Recently, they opened a canteen in our college. There are no sports in our college.
The hostel is not so bad but the food is not so good, as I hear from my friends.

reviews.review_text: Our college has a very good infrastructure with two sub-buildings. One has four floors, and the other has seven. It has all kinds of labs. It has a small garden and a ground with a separate packing area and a sitting area.

hostel_campus.college_name: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Good because of faculty and college infrastructure are so well-structured.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure is well-structured and well-built. In our college, there are two hostels, the first one is an old hostel and the second one is a new hostel. In the new hostel, the facilities are very good like providing Wi-Fi, mess, canteen and also a sports complex is there.

reviews.review_heading: 2022 ADCET Sangli review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in my college was really very impressive. There were good classrooms. There was a big library. There was also Wi-Fi but we did not have network for that Wi-Fi. Also, hostel was very clean and good. There were two hostels, old boys hostel and new boys hostel. Mess food was also average. But canteen of our college provided tasty food. Also, there was a sports complex. Many games in that complex were there. Gym was also there.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the college, faculty members, and the infrastructure. Placements are
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. Labs are advanced and customized. Classrooms are big and highly advanced. The library has more than 1.5 lakh books. A digital library is also provided and it has a separate study room for competitive exam preparation. Hostels are good with better security. The college also provides a sports complex for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our review towards the growing college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was renewed last year as there are a lot of improvements in their NAAC accreditation and ranking of our college. All labs had the proper instruments and were up to the mark. They had their own gym and separate girls' and boys' hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Our college placements are very good.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us Wi-Fi with good speed. We have well labs and also provide digital classrooms. There is also a digital library.

reviews.review_heading: If there are no options, then take admission. All Tier 3 colleges are more or less the same, I think
reviews.review_text: Overall, infrastructure was okay. The best infrastructure was sport complex of the college in which there were a lot of facilities including, sports badminton, chess, pool, and table tennis. There were classes for yoga, dance, and singing but hostel infrastructure and facilities were not up to money.

reviews.review_heading: A pleasing place to be at and create memories to cherish lifelong.
reviews.review_text: There is great food to choose from multiple canteens, one of the biggest and cleanest gymkhanas, a green environment, and lots of campus areas to chill and hangout. There is a big library with a digital library as well. The gymkhana has so many activities, that too at a very minimal cost per semester. You can learn dance, musical instruments, table tennis, use the badminton court, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a good engineering college in the Sangli district.
reviews.review_text: In my department, labs are available, and in every lab, at least 20 computers are provided. My department also provides Wi-Fi to all PCs. The medical and hostel facilities are also good. The mess is also good in hostels, and the environment of the hostel is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good in teaching and good placement every year.
reviews.review_text: We have good faculty members in our college. They teach both technical and communication skills. They also share different platforms for students' practice purposes. The college has an infrastructure ground and also a cultural and sports committee. After college time, students use that ground for exercise and playing purposes.

reviews.review_heading: A good choice if you have an average score in the entrance exam.
reviews.review_text: Old Boys' Hostels are not good at all, but the new ones are quite good. You can take rooms outside the campus at the same price and with better services. While talking about academic infrastructure, it's getting better day by day, like they are upgrading computer systems and other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Quality Education and Facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has Wi-Fi, well-organized labs, and classrooms. We also have a big library. The food available in the canteen is also good, and our college is also active in sports and games. Our college has good infrastructure. There are lab sessions for batches, so teachers can focus on particular students and improve their performance in labs and the curriculum.

reviews.review_heading: Best Facilities and Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the labs and hostels is the best. There are 5 hostels in our college and more than 100 labs. The best facilities are provided by our college. The best part is that there is one ladies’ hostel, which is very good, and the facilities are the best. For boys, there are also good hostels.

reviews.review_heading: There is an excellent improvement from the year 2021.
reviews.review_text: I will give 5 out of 5 for labs and infrastructure. But for the hostel, I would rate 4 out of 5. For labs, they are going with advanced technology and having changes in the syllabus as they are teaching practicals with ongoing trends. Hostel facility is average and taking room outside is a better option.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfy faculty members, but training and placement cells should improve.
reviews.review_text: There are 4-5 hostels on the college campus, all of which have very good infrastructure. The food available in all the hostels is average; therefore, hostelers prefer to go outside of the campus for mess. The Sports Complex has excellent sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with everything provided.
reviews.review_text: Our course is provided with a department floor, where we have CAD and CFD labs. We also have an aerodynamics lab with wind turbines and a structure lab with many materials and design testing equipment. Speaking about hostels, for our course, especially for the students who enroll from faraway places, boys and girls have two hostel buildings separately with a luxurious stay area and water.

paragraphs: Rama University admissionis currentlyopenfor various UG & PG courses. The university offers several undergraduate, postgraduate & Integrated courses in the stream of Science, Law, Engineering, Science, etc. Rama University admissions are entrance-based. Admission to all the courses atRama Universityis done through a valid scores of candidates inRama University Entrance Test (RUET)for all the UG & PG courses. Additionally, the university also accepts valid scores ofCUET UG & CUET PGentrance exams for the respective courses. As per the Rama University admission process, the shortlisted candidates are called for anInterview round. At last, the final seats are allocated via a counselling process. The in-depth details around Rama University admission 2025 are explained in the article below.

Rama University accepts scores of various entrance exams for admission to all itsUG & PG courses, including CUET, RUET, NEET, etc. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements before applying for the respective courses. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to Rama University course admission 2025:
Class 12 in PCM with 50% aggregate
UG degree in any stream with 50% aggregate from a recognised university
Class 12 in Commerce stream with 50% aggregate from a recognised board
Class 12 with 50% aggregate in PCM/ PCB
Class 12 with 50% aggregate
UG degree in BTech with 60% aggregate
Class 12 with 50% aggregate
Note:Candidates have to pay an additional one-time Registration Fee of INR 6,000 and a per semester-wise Examination Fee of INR 3,500.
Download:Rama University Fee Structure (2023-24)

The Rama University admission process 2025 is consists of multiple steps, including fulfilling the basic eligibility criteria, qualifying for the selection criteria and filling an application form. Check below the detailed process for Rama University Kanpur admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Rama University application process is conducted in both online and offline modes. Candidates can either fill an online application form on the university's official website for their desired programme. However, the offline process is also valid at Rama University. Candidates can download the application form, fill it and submit it with a demand draft of INR 1,000 at the admission office of Rama University.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Rama University admission is entirely entrance-based for all the UG & PG courses. The university commonly conducts its in-house entrance exam, i.e., RUET for the selection of eligible candidates. However, candidates are also shortlisted based on scores of various national-level entrance exams such as CUET, NEET, etc. Later on, the final selection is based on the performance of candidates in a PI round.
Step 3: Counselling Process

At last, the selected candidates are called for a university-level counselling process. The final seat allotment is done during the counselling. Further, the selected candidates need to pay a certain fee as perRama University fee structureto confirm admission.

reviews.review_heading: All the facilities are even good and it also gives us the chance to make our future brighter.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is as good as much. Infrastructure of hostel and college is good and comfortable. They provide us with a safe and ragging-free environment for each student who is a part of this university. Hostel food quality is also good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, I live my most beautiful years, making many friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Classrooms are good for students, and labs are too good. The library is available for students. The canteen and mess food are good and tasty. They maintain hygiene for students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good, I got very good placement in 2015 and also got very good companies.
reviews.review_text: All types of facilities were available in the college, including lift facilities, Wi-Fi, filtered water, and good infrastructure. The college had very good faculty members who taught well and were very supportive, with help available at every place. The college was really good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rama University.
reviews.review_text: There were many buildings and campus was beautiful. Hostel was available, and you could use free Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library. Hostel mess was very good every day and they provided different meals like breakfast, lunch, and dinner. There was balcony available and filtered water. Our campus was ragging free. There were two beds in every room.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rama University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, and a library are available. There is no maintenance of anything. The quality of classrooms is okay. Students can also hang out in the mess and canteen area.

reviews.review_heading: Everyone can go through the review without error.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the faculty members area but only for the official and faculty staff. The quality of the food and facilities in hostels and university should be improved. Sports and games are only held annually. The chance of participation is very less.

reviews.review_heading: I got disappointment in the placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is quite impressive and effective. The course I have selected at the university does not have many facilities. The university should have done better in that field, and the management of the hostel was not so good. No renovation was done, and everything remained the same for about 6 years.

reviews.review_heading: Rama University is the best college in the location for Kanpur, and the best placements are provided
reviews.review_text: The hostel of the university is quite nice. Everyone treats us like friends or even helps us a lot. There is a lift in the university, and it has also been provided a lot of facilities. Hostel food is very tasty and healthy. All the food is organic.

reviews.review_heading: My university is best for medical, dental and agriculture. My university have good faculty.
reviews.review_text: My department has all the facilities, including Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, a library, expert lectures, a canteen, a bookshop, a park, a ground, a nursery, and a polyhouse. My department hostel also has all the facilities, including Wi-Fi, air-conditioned rooms, medical facilities, indoor and outdoor games, a park, a ground, a canteen, and a mess.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is very big and it also organises various types of events.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good and clean. Wi-Fi is provided to all students who live in the hostel. Students can go to library to study on weekends. Food is available for students who live in the hostel, and one can make their own food. Classrooms are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Drama University is working for the bright future .
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities available for students, including a library, Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and many laboratories. All are clean and a better-working canteen and mess provide great food. We usually sit in the cafeteria during breaks and enjoy the meals.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides peaceful environment and is good for studying.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, the college provides 150 acres of campus, you can take free breath, and the library is also good with 24*7 Wi-Fi. The college is best for studying; there are also festivals and extra-cultural activities. The college provides a peaceful and prosperous environment.

reviews.review_heading: The college is really nice, and the environment is good; exams happen on time.
reviews.review_text: There is 24/7 Wi-Fi, and you can use the library until 8 PM. You can sit nicely and study; there is 5G Wi-Fi that you can use without fail. The environment of the college is very good; you can take admission here as it provides a nice environment for students.

admission_overview.title: Guwahati University Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Guwahati University's admission process is completely online, and for a majority of its courses, it is subject to candidates' performance in an entrance test conducted by the university. Guwahati University is a public state university that started with 18 affiliated colleges and 8 Post Graduate Departments in 1948. It offers UG, PG, diploma, certificate, and doctoral courses via its departments and constituent colleges and 325 affiliated colleges. At the campus, the university offers only postgraduate courses while all the other UG, Diploma, Certificate, and PhD courses are offered via its constituent and affiliated colleges. It also has an Institute of Distance and Open Learning (IDOL) to offer distance learning programmes to students. In order to apply to Gauhati University, visit the official site of the university, apply online, and complete the application form. In undergraduate education, admission is usually done on the basis of CUET or a merit list, whereas in BTech, JEE Mains scores are taken into consideration. To pursue postgraduate studies, an applicant usually has to pass an entrance examination and have an interview or counselling. Once you have applied, you might be asked to download a fee challan and pay.

faqs.question: How can I get admission for MBA at Guwahati University?
faqs.answer: Gauhati University MBA admission is completely based on the merit scores obtained by students in the university/national-level entrance exam along with their merit at the undergraduate level. The university conducts its own entrance exam for admission. However, those with a valid score in national-level entrances, such asMAT/CAT/XAT/CMATexams are exempted from this test provided they have a score of 75 percentile and above. Those who qualify one of the afore-mentioned exams are required to go through a GDPI round for final selection. Before everything else, students must meet with the minimum eligibility criteria set by the university which is to pass a relevant undergraduate degree with at least 50% aggregate. However, those who are in the final year of their UG degree can also apply provided they have no arrears in the previous semesters and fulfill the complete eligibility before first semester exams.

faqs.question: How many marks are required in JEE Main to get admission in Guwahati University BTech?

Cut-offs differ annually based on competition and seat intake. Good scores enhance admission chances in Guwahati University.

faqs.question: Is admission to Gauhati University merit-based or entrance-based?
faqs.answer: Gauhati University offers admissions on the basis of merit and entrance, both. The university requires entrance exam including CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, CUET, Assam CEE, JEE Main, NEET PG, GATE, Asaam JMEE, Andhra Pradesh PECET, etc. to offer admission to the courses. To get admission to Gauhati University, candidates must fulfil the course-specific eligibility.

Admission Process-The admission process is divided into the following stages:Stage I: Online registration and fee payment,Stage II: Filling out the application form,Stage III: Seat allotment,Stage IV: Physical reporting and admission in the allotted institutes.
Stage One: Online registration and fee payment

A candidate is required to register online on CAM (Centralised Admission for MArch/MTech admission) website. Pay the application form fees of CAM, which is INR 3000 (INR 1500/for SC/ST category) this includes 18 % GST. Fees can be submitted online through any online payment gateway details. A candidate is required to pay any other admissible charges as per the requirement of online payment, as applicable. A transaction ID will be generated after the payment.
Stage Two: Filling out the application form

In order to activate the online application form by entering the required details, the candidate must enter the transaction ID in the appropriate column of the application form. Then thecandidate will be allowed to fill out the application form with their personal and academic details as per the requirements.
Stage Three: Online choice filling
All the valid registered candidates are required to exercise their choices of programs and institutes in order of their preference for these programs / Institutes.
Stage Four: Seat allotment

As per the tentative schedule, the choices submitted by the candidates will be processed centrally and seats will be allotted in the order of merit (as per the rules of merit) on the basis of the locked choices. The allotment of institute and specialization to the candidate will be carried out through the computer software by strictly following the order of merit, seats available, reservation rules and the order of options filled by the candidate.
Stage Five: Physical reporting & admission

A candidate, who has been allotted a seat shall required to report at the allotted institute as per the tentative schedule. A provisional seat allotment letter may be printed from the CAM-website using the login details.

RIET Kerala admissions are merit/ entrance-based.Admissions for UG programmes are granted though Commissioner for Entrance Examination (CEE) or Management Quota in the ratio of 50:50. For PG admissions, students must hold a BTech degree from a recognised university. Further, students must also go through a PI round, if required.
Step 3: Final Admission

admission_overview.college_name: Dibrugarh University Course Admissions 2025: Courses, Eligibility, Dates & Application Process

paragraphs: Dibrugarh University offers admission on the basis ofmeritandentrance examscores. The university offers courses in streams like Commerce, Engineering, Social Science, etc. These courses are offered at the undergraduate, post graduate, and doctoral level. It has its own entrance exams likeDUPGET, DURAT, BED CET that are conducted for courses like MA, PhD, and BEd, respectively. Further, the Dibrugarh University accepts entrance exams likeCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE.

Dibrugarh University admissionto courses is either entrance-based or merit-based. The University offers a variety of UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the streams ofHumanities & Social Sciences,Science,Commerce,Engineering,Teaching & EducationandMedical & Health Sciences.Dibrugarh Universityoffers most of the UG courses via its affiliated colleges, where admission is merit-based. The university offers PG courses through more than 10 departments and centres of the university. Admission to these courses is done by the university's in-house entrance exams such asDUPGET,DURAT, B.ED CET for MA, PhD, and B.Ed, respectively.For courses such as MBA and MTech, the university accepts valid scores ofCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE, respectively.

Admission to allDibrugarh University courses(UG, PG, diploma and others) is both merit and entrance-based. Eligible candidates can register online by visiting the official website of the university and its affiliated colleges as per the opted courses. The following table mentions the eligibility, selection & fee for some of thepopular UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes:

Dibrugarh University course feesinclude various components such as admission fees, caution deposits, tuition fees, etc. Some of these components, such as the security fee are one-time chargeable. Other components could be refundable, non-refundable, to be paid semester-wise or annually. Dibrugarh University admission processfor all courses is conductedonlineon its official website. Interested candidates must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and appear for the selection process, determined by the University. Eligible candidates have to begin their admission process by filling out the Dibrugarh University application form before the deadline. Aspirants canrefer to the below steps to complete the Dibrugarh University admission process:
Step 1: Dibrugarh University Application process
TheDU application formsare released online on the university's official website. Candidates must fill out the application form very carefully and pay the required application fee before the deadline.
Step 2: Dibrugarh University Selection Process

The admission criteria for DU courses are bothmerit-based and entrance-based. For admission to entrance-based courses, candidates need to appear for the relevant entrance exam. DU accepts various national-level entrance exam scores to shortlist candidates for final admission.
For admission to merit-based courses,Dibrugarh Univeristyshortlists candidates based on their scores in the qualifying exam.
Step 3: Dibrugarh University Admission Confirmation

After all the selection rounds are over. DU releases a merit list on the official website. Shortlisted candidates are required to pay the admission confirmation fee and appear for the document verification process to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BBA at Dibrugarh University?
faqs.answer: Dibrugarh University BBA is a 3 year, UG level course offered on the basis of merit and entrance. Candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 50% in Class 12 and qualify previous examination. The tuition fee is between INR 60K - INR 1.7 Lakh.

faqs.question: What is the fee for Dibrugarh University?
faqs.answer: Dibrugarh University offers courses in UG, PG and Doctoral levels in distance and full-time mode. The University offers courses such as BTech, BEd, MA, MBA and many more with duration varying from 1 year to 5 years. Dibrugarh University Assam fee structure includes courses with tuition fees ranging from INR 1K to INR 6.25 Lakh.

faqs.question: What is the fees for the MBA course at Dibrugarh University?
faqs.answer: The fee at Dibrugarh University for MBA falls between INR 33 K and INR 3.5 lakh. Candidates must pay the fees via any of the payment modes after the selection process is over.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, Dibrugarh University outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 50 ranks to #151 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed stability in trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Dibrugarh University's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 10 ranks to #53 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'State Public University' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 2 ranks to #30 rank in the 'State Public University' category by the NIRF ranking.

Hostels seemed reasonable, and the college infrastructure was better than AEC, JEC, and other state government colleges. Giving you a good feel when you are still inside the campus.

review_content.Placements: I’m currently in the 2nd year of B.Tech Computer Science (BTCS) at Kalinga University, Raipur. I’m sharing my honest view about placements here so far, based on what seniors and faculty have told us. The college has a decent placement cell. They organize sessions on aptitude, coding, resume building, and soft skills from the 3rd year onwards. Seniors told me that companies like TCS, Wipro, HCL, and some local startups do visit the campus. Most of the packages are between 2.5 and 4 LPA, depending on your skills.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Kalinga University is modern and well-maintained, with smart classrooms, computer labs, a central library, and Wi-Fi across campus. The campus is spacious and green. Hostels are decent with 24/7 security, basic furniture, and attached washrooms. Mess food is average but hygienic. There’s a common room, laundry, and medical facilities. Overall, hostel life is comfortable for students.

review_summary.college_name: Kalinga University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best University for education.

content.Placements: Kalinga University is the best University in Raipur, known for its quality education and placement records. The University placement cell has highly qualified and experienced faculty. The University placement cell conducts training, i.e., they take mock interviews, mock tests, etc., so that students perform well in their placement drive. Approximately 95 percent of students get placed in the on-campus placement drive. The highest package is 30 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The University is NAAC accredited with an A+ grade and is ranked in the 200-250 band by NIRF in 2021. The University has a large library, a central Instrumentation Facility with advanced apparatus, and an Innovation and Incubation Cell to support startups. The University conducts many events like sports events, cultural fests, and many more. Facilities provided for the hosteler are quite good. The quality of mess food is average.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Law (LL.B.) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good college. Faculty members are very good at helping everyone.

content.Placements: Placements are average. If you are a skilled student, then you will get easily placed in an off-campus placement. Many students here are preparing for a government exam like GATE, CAT, and the UPSC exam. The environment of this college is quite good for studying. Placement is good.
content.Infrastructure: My overall experience with campus life at college has been very enriching, both academically and socially. The college organizes an annual cultural and technical festival. The library is well-stocked with a wide range of books. The rooms are well cleaned, and the food is hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus, faculty, and life – my real experience at Kalinga.

content.Placements: Placements for B. Pharmacy are average at Kalinga University. Some companies visit for campus recruitment, but students mostly need to apply off-campus as well. The university provides guidance for internships and job opportunities, but students should also focus on building skills and networking on their own to get better placement offers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the B. Pharmacy course at Kalinga University is decent but could be improved. Labs have the basic equipment required for practicals, and classes usually have proper seating and projectors. The hostel facilities are average, and the rooms are manageable but can be better maintained. Basic amenities like Wi-Fi, water supply, and mess are available, but sometimes need improvements. Overall, the infrastructure is okay for studies and the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Sep 2024) - B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty and modern campus, but placements need improvement.

content.Placements: I’m currently in the 2nd year of B.Tech Computer Science (BTCS) at Kalinga University, Raipur. I’m sharing my honest view about placements here so far, based on what seniors and faculty have told us. The college has a decent placement cell. They organize sessions on aptitude, coding, resume building, and soft skills from the 3rd year onwards. Seniors told me that companies like TCS, Wipro, HCL, and some local startups do visit the campus. Most of the packages are between 2.5 and 4 LPA, depending on your skills.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Kalinga University is modern and well-maintained, with smart classrooms, computer labs, a central library, and Wi-Fi across campus. The campus is spacious and green. Hostels are decent with 24/7 security, basic furniture, and attached washrooms. Mess food is average but hygienic. There’s a common room, laundry, and medical facilities. Overall, hostel life is comfortable for students.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Sep 2024) - B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college. Worth it.

content.Placements: 70 percent of students were placed last year in top companies. The highest placement salary was 12 LPA while the lowest was 3 LPA. The average salary was 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Infosys Accenture and others. 70 percent of students from my course received internships at leading tech companies like Google.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at the institution is quite good featuring a large library and a spacious sports complex on campus along with widespread Wi Fi availability throughout the campus and hostel. Our hostel rooms are quite spacious and equipped with a full Wi Fi connection and CCTV for security.

admission_overview.college_name: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection, Application Process

admission_process.title: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Admission process 2025

paragraphs: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education admissionto all courses, except for BTech and BArch, is merit-based. TheKAHE BTech admission criteria are entrance-based;the institute accepts national-level entrance exam scores, such as JEE Main and NATA scores, to shortlist candidates for admission. For other courses, admission is given based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria and performance in the qualifying exam. The application process for the university commences online. Interested candidates have to visit the official website and download the application form from the relevant section. Further, candidates need to send the admission form along with the required documents to the official email ID given on the website. Interested students can read the following article to learn all about the courses, eligibility criteria, and admission process forKAHE.

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education offers more than 15 courses viafour facultiesat theUG and PG levels.The courses are offered in different areas of study such asManagement, Law,Artsand Humanities,Engineering, etc. The University also offers acertificate course in Data Science.

As per the KAHE official website, admission to the BTech and BArch programmes is done based on the performance of the candidates in JEE Main and NATA, respectively. Admission to other KAHE courses is merit-based. However, candidates need to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course to be considered for admission at KAHE. Interested candidates can check out the table below for the general eligibility and selection criteria for popularKAHE courses:

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education feesvary course-wise. The KAHE fee ranges between INR 1.2 L and INR 15 L. Candidates need to pay the course fee at the time of admission to confirm their seat at the institute. Below is theKAHE feeand average package for all courses:
Note: The fees mentioned above is taken from official sources and is subject to change.

The KAHE seat intake for each course is different and depends on various factors such as the number of applications received for that course, the number of specialisations offered, etc. The table below shows the course-wise total seat intake of KAHE courses:

KAHE evaluates the performance of the candidate in the qualifying exam to shortlist candidates for admission to all courses, except for BTech and BArch. Candidates seeking admission to BTech and BArch courses are required to appear for the course-specific entrance exams.

Eligible candidates can begin theirKAHE course admission processby applying to the desired course through the official website. The Karpagam Academy of Higher Education application process is mentioned below:
Step 1: KAHE Application Process

KAHE application processis conducted inonline mode. Candidates can visit the official website of the institute and download the application form. After filling the form, they need to mail the duly filled form, along with the demand draft, on registrar@kahedu.edu.in.
Step 2: Selection Process

KAHE offers direct admission to candidateson the basis of the merit obtained in the qualifying exam. However, forBTech and BArch admission,candidates must have a valid score in JEE Main and NATA, respectively.
Step 3: Result Declaration and Admission Confirmation

After the selection rounds are completed, KAHE releases a merit list on its official website with the names of selected applicants. The candidates are required to appear for the document verification round and pay the admission fee to secure their admission.
